# dibujo de prueba
fill_rect 0 0 4 4 red; set_pixel 1 1 "#00ff00"
pxcli set_pixel 2 2 '#0000ff'
./pxcli get_pixel 1 1
set_pixel 9 9 red
stop
set_pixel x 1 red
// comentario
   line 0 0 3 3 blue   ;   ;
nope 1 2
undo
get_pixel 3 3
get_pixel 2 2
export --scale 2 out.png
export --scale=99 out.png
export --scale 2
batch 'x'
clear transparent
new 8 8
get_pixel 0 0
set_pixel 7 7 white
undo
redo
redo
get_pixel 7 7
